title: Dungeon mob kill XP raised about 20% (Oct 8 build)
claim: Since the Oct 8 beta build (1.60.1.70291), killing creatures in dungeons gives about 20% more XP than in the Oct 1 build.
detail: Partly reverses the earlier dungeon mob XP reduction (n:20261008-dungeon-mob-xp-reduced); dungeon kills are still below Classic Era rates. Comes together with the party XP fix (n:20261009-party-xp-own-level), which Blizzard expects to be the bigger gain for most players. Forum testers report 1.2 to 2.5+ level bars per run at 30, unverified.

title: Party kill XP now uses each member's own level (Era rule)
claim: Since Oct 8, party kill XP is computed from each member's own level vs the mob (as in Classic Era), not from the highest-level party member; if any member is far above the mob's level, nobody in the party gets XP.
detail: Before the fix, a low-level player grouped with a higher-level one got heavily reduced XP per kill (the penalty followed the highest level in the group). Blizzard says the second rule (a member for whom the mob is trivial blocks XP for all) is intended, so carries/boost runs by much higher characters still give 0 XP. Matters for any group leveling: dungeons, elite quests, duo questing.

title: Blizzard target: optimal dungeon leveling about as fast as optimal questing
claim: Aggrend (Oct 8): after the Oct 8 fixes, optimal dungeon leveling should be about as fast as optimal questing or very close, but not at Era rates; dungeon cleaving to 60 is against the design pillars and will not be restored.
detail: Design intent statement, not a number. Read with n:20261008-dungeon-quest-bonus-xp-halved (run each dungeon once or twice for its quests) and n:20261009-dungeon-kill-xp-up-20.

title: Rage gain fixed and retuned for questing Warriors and Druids
claim: Oct 8: Rage from dealing damage is now balanced around 20-40% armor reduction (varies by level) instead of 50% tank armor, and three bugs were fixed (Rage used the player's health instead of the creature's, ignored crit/crushing multipliers, and counted absorbs), so typical Warriors and Druids gain more Rage; Druid crit Rage bonus is 100% (was 75%).
detail: Biggest effect is on DPS/questing Warriors: more Stamina gear no longer lowers Rage. Bear/Dire Bear threat bonus 50% (was 30%); Druids can drink Mana Potions in forms; Cat Form no longer lowers max health. A forum tester still sees reduced threat per rage from Rage Potions.

title: Tirisfal Glades: quest and mob levels raised around Shadowvale and Bandarion Keep
claim: Oct 8: quests and creatures around Shadowvale and Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades were raised in level because they were lower than the preceding content and turned green before players reached them.
detail: New numbers not published; the data repos will show them once harvested. Kill and quest XP there goes up (higher mob/quest levels), so the Tirisfal route order may change.

title: Desolace: new Gelkis/Magram quest chain now requires level 35
claim: The new Gelkis and Magram quests in Desolace that start with "Valley of Bones" now require level 35 (was 30); a coming hotfix makes their 16 rewards require level 35 to equip.
detail: Affects post-beta routes (cap is 30 in beta): the chain can't be picked up at 30-34.

title: Hillsbrad "Elixir of Pain": Stanley gives no kill XP; quest XP raised by that amount
claim: Oct 8: during "Elixir of Pain" in Hillsbrad Foothills, Stanley no longer gives kill XP; the quest reward now includes the XP that used to come from him.
detail: Net XP unchanged for a normal completion; the kill-XP split in the model should move to the quest.

title: Faster respawns and drops for several quests (Oct 8)
claim: Oct 8: faster respawn or more objects for Durotar "Break A Few Eggs" (Taillasher Eggs), Redridge "Blackrock Blockade" (weapon racks, stolen weapons, supplies), Teldrassil "Destiny Calls" (Sethir and his minions), the Shaman "Storm, Earth, and Fire" mobs (plus higher Twisted Totem drop rates and more sources), and the Warrior "Ulag the Cleaver" trigger; Mulgore Gloomrise creatures respawn more evenly; Loch Modan "Resupplying the Excavation" spawns fewer Dark Iron Ambushers.
detail: Also: "Heed My Call" Eye of the Tempest is multi-drop; Gloomrise Hatchlings now give XP fitting their difficulty; larger Dustbelcher camps (e.g. Dustbelch Grotto) respawn faster, smaller ones don't. No timers published.

title: Low ranks of main nukes and heals retuned so every new rank is an upgrade
claim: Oct 8: base and per-level values of the low ranks of Wrath (1-5), Frostbolt (1-5), Fireball (1-5), Arcane Missiles (1-3), Smite (1-4), Lesser Heal (1-3)/Heal (1-2), Lightning Bolt (1-5) and Shadow Bolt (1-4) were adjusted so damage/healing grows evenly up to the next rank and each new rank is always an upgrade.
detail: Exact values not published; affects caster damage per level while leveling. Also: Retribution Aura back to Vanilla damage (~33% less, 6% SP ratio), Thorns back to Vanilla (6% SP ratio), Penance cut, Demoralizing Shout/Roar now cause threat.

title: Hunter: Improved Concussive Shot proc chance corrected (100% was a bug)
claim: The Oct 8 notes say Improved Concussive Shot "now has the correct proc chance", so the datamined 100% stun proc was a bug and no longer applies; Improved Wing Clip was also corrected and procs less with ranks far below your level.
detail: Corrected value not published. Also Oct 8: Disengage threat reduction doubled; Expose Prey lasts 10 s (was 5); Unleashed Fury now raises pet damage.

title: Legacy perks that speed up leveling (Talented, Well Rested, Field Guide, Frequent Flier, Permanence)
claim: The Legacy system (16 spendable points per character at launch, 1 point per Legacy Challenge) includes perks that speed leveling: Talented (talent points up to 5 levels earlier), Well Rested (higher rested cap, faster rested gain), Field Guide (shorter 1-hour camp cooldown), Frequent Flier (cheaper, faster flights), Permanence (longer camp buffs), Gourmand (longer food buffs), Thrill of Adventure (small HP/mana per non-trivial kill).
detail: Points come from 65 challenges: each class reaching 25/45/60 (27), crafting professions at 150/225/300 (18), PvP (12), exploration and the Valthalak chain (2), dungeon groups (3), raids (3). A first character at launch has no points until level 25 or 150 crafting skill, so Talented etc. mostly help alts. Beta characters were all granted 16 points on Oct 8 (n:20261009-legacy-beta-grant). Per-rank numbers: see n:20261009-legacy-perk-numbers.

title: Legacy perk values: Frequent Flier -50% cost/+20% flight speed, Field Guide -8% camp cooldown, Talented from level 9 down to 5
claim: Per the beta client tree: Frequent Flier (1 rank) 50% flight-path discount and 20% faster flights; Field Guide (3 ranks) camp cooldown -8%; Talented (5 ranks) first talent point at level 9, down to 5 at 5 ranks (51 points max); Well Rested (5 ranks) rested gain and cap +4%; Permanence (2 ranks) class buffs and camp rest +50% duration; Gourmand (3 ranks) food buff duration +33%.
detail: Single guide source; whether the % is per rank or for all ranks is not stated for every perk. The tree hides 2 more perks per tree in the beta. Daybreak Forever lists 24 Legacy perks in build 70291.

title: Beta: every character granted 16 Legacy Points; Legacy respec costs 1s
claim: Oct 8: all beta players received the Legacy Challenge (16 Legacy Points), and the cheapest Legacy re-spec now costs 1s and drops one step per hour (beta only).
detail: 16 is also the per-character spending cap at launch, so beta testers can try full Talented/Well Rested setups now. Forum players ask for Legacy power to be removed; no Blizzard answer.

title: Beta ends Oct 22 at cap 30; launch Nov 4
claim: The beta runs until Oct 22 and stays at level cap 30; name reservation Oct 27-Nov 3; launch Nov 4, 2026; raids unlock Dec 9.
detail: No further beta cap raise announced. Launch-day leveling is 1-60 with no level cap increases planned.

title: Next beta build expected Oct 15
claim: Blizzard designer Aidan Moon (Zirene) marks several bugs on the community tracker as fixed "October 15th", so the next beta build is expected Oct 15; Aggrend said on the podcast that Orc and Troll active racials may be nerfed in next week's build.
detail: Fixes named for Oct 15: Leader of the Pack toggling through forms, Cat Form mana potion. Racial details unknown.

title: Beta: characters logged out in Loch Modan or Badlands can't log in
claim: Since the Oct 8 build, characters logged out in Loch Modan (Thelsamar inn, near the Wetlands gate) and in Badlands hang on the loading screen; no workaround or GM answer yet.
detail: Beta-only: log out elsewhere (e.g. Ironforge or Menethil) until fixed.

title: Cozy Sleeping Bag: +1% XP per minute napped, up to +3% for 1 hour
claim: The Cozy Sleeping Bag (item 211527, quest chain from level 14) gives +1% XP per minute napped on it, up to 3 stacks (+3% for 1 hour), on a 1-hour cooldown; it counts as a rested area and stacks with camp and food buffs.
detail: Chain: Westfall Nailed Plank 37,50 (Alliance start) <-> Barrens Burned-Out Remains 46,74 (Horde start) -> Stonetalon camp near Sun Rock Retreat -> Loch Modan Carved Figurine 49,12 (Stonewrought Dam) -> Hillsbrad northern Thoradin Wall satchel. Not usable in cities or inns; disappears if you move ~100 yd away. Same item as Season of Discovery.

title: Crafted food buff: +5% kill XP for 15 minutes
claim: Cooked (crafted) food gives +5% XP from kills (not quests) for 15 minutes, on top of the food's normal stats (e.g. Tasty Raptor Bites).
detail: From the BlizzCon reveal; stacks with camp rested and the sleeping bag. Gourmand (Legacy) extends the duration.

title: Hunter pets: fast-attacking beasts do ~26% more DPS; Claw adds ~20%
claim: A level 30 combat-log test found a 1.2-speed wolf does ~26% more total DPS than a 2.0-speed wolf with the same stats (46.6 vs 36.9), and a 1.2-speed cat (Claw + Bite) ~20% more than a 1.2-speed wolf (56.1 vs 46.6).
detail: Tame the fastest beast of a family (pets range 1.0-2.5 attack speed; Broken Tooth cat 1.0; Zul'Gurub bats 1.0). One tester, ~20 min per pet; not confirmed by Blizzard.

title: Shaman: Shield Specialization and Weapon Mastery are not baseline
claim: Blizzard (Zirene) says the class article listing Shield Specialization and Weapon Mastery as baseline for Shamans was a mix-up; they are not baseline in Forever.
detail: Plan Shaman talents without assuming them.

title: Auto Shot still has a 0.1-0.2 s cast; ranged code being reworked
claim: Auto Shot still has a 0.1-0.2 s cast time (Throw 0.5 s); Blizzard (Zirene) calls it a known issue and says ranged code is being reworked.
detail: Melee swings also put Warrior ranged attacks on cooldown (issue #14).

title: Dungeon mob kill XP reduced (partly reversed Oct 8)
claim: Dungeon creature kill XP in Forever is below Classic Era; the Oct 8 build raised it about 20% again (n:20261009-dungeon-kill-xp-up-20).
detail: Blizzard (Aggrend) confirms Era rates will not return. Numbers for the base reduction still unpublished.
